content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Update the Event Object Page Layout ## slug: update-event-object-page-layout ## seoTitle: Update the Event Object Page Layout ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The following fields need to be added to the Event object page layout. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndDate}} (conference360__Ticket_Sales_End_Date__c) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndTime}} (conference360__Ticket_Sales_End_Time__c) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}} (conference360__Ticket_Sales_Start_Date__c) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartTime}} (conference360__Ticket_Sales_Start_Time__c) 1. Click the **Gear icon** in the upper right hand corner. 2. Click **Setup**. 3. Click the Object Manager tab. 4. In the Quick Find box, enter “Event.” 5. Click Event (conference360__Event__c). 6. Click Page Layout. 7. Click Event Layout. 8. Locate the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndDate}} field. 9. Decide where on the page layout the field should go and drag and drop it there. 10. Repeat Steps 8 and 9 for the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndTime}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartTime}} fields. 11. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}.
